note: Local A2 word list for learner-visible Dutch in A2 reading, listening, writing and speaking batches from 087 onward. Every word of config/a1-vocabulary.json also counts. This is our own editorial choice of common everyday words for the inburgering A2 domains, not an official CEFR list. scripts/a2-vocabulary.ts matches inflected forms (plurals, -e adjectives, comparatives, present and past tense, participles, separable verbs, diminutives), spelled-out numbers and two-part compounds of listed words. A reading text or listening script may contain one unlisted word per 50 words when the context explains it and no question depends on it; titles, situations, prompts, questions, options, explanations, criteria, scaffolds, form labels, models, alts and starters may not. Authors do not edit this file; they report a needed word to the coordinator, who adds it only when it is an everyday word an A2 learner meets in a normal inburgering course.
decided: 2026-11-05: the user found some A2 words far too hard (for example oplaadaansluiting, scheenbeschermers, loonheffing, kentekenbewijs). This list is the gate for new A2 batches. Later the same day the user judged English cognates (corporatie, thermostaat, certificaat, prepaidkaart), transparent compounds and plain everyday words easy enough for A2; only really hard words stay out.
